title: Recovery Share for Retried Drafts on a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Training questions — the recovery share of a Patient Payment Plan returned-payment fee**

**What is the recovery share?**
A recovery share follows the returned draft's retry: where a later automatic collection for the same installment was received and at least 6 installments were collected by automatic payment within the last 12 months, the share is 0.6; where that later collection was received and fewer installments were collected so, the share is 0.8; where no automatic collection for that installment was received the recovery share is one. The returned-payment fee is multiplied by the recovery share.

**What is "the same installment"?**
The installment whose automatic draft came back unpaid, identified by its due date; a later automatic collection for it is a payment received through automatic payment that carries that due date.

**How are the 6 collections counted?**
Installments received through automatic payment on the plan whose receipt falls within the last 12 months, that is, fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date by the day recorded.

## Table

| Later automatic collection received for the returned installment | Automatic collections within the last 12 months | Recovery share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 6 or more | 0.6 |
| Yes | 5 or fewer | 0.8 |
| No | Any number | 1 |

## Hypothetical cases

- The draft for the 2026-05-01 installment came back; the retry three days later collected it, and the plan shows 10 automatic collections in the last 12 months: share 0.6.
- Same, with only 4 automatic collections in the last 12 months: share 0.8.
- No automatic collection carries the 2026-05-01 due date: share one.
